source: NOAA GHCN-Daily audit; actual valid daily records only

tierRules.robust: Each element >=90% of all calendar days and >=24 of 30 years with >=80% annual coverage
tierRules.acceptable: Each element >=80% of all calendar days and >=20 of 30 years with >=80% annual coverage
tierRules.limited: All three elements have some valid records but do not meet acceptable threshold
tierRules.unusable: At least one required element has zero valid days
